title: Paired CUPTI-run + NVBit-run manifest
description: Closed-object schema for a `dual_run_manifest.json` recording the pairing between a CUPTI-Activity timing run and a NVBit-instrumented trace run on the same kernel set. The dual-run protocol exists because NVBit instrumentation (LD_PRELOAD + CUDA_INJECTION64_PATH) and the CUPTI Activity collector cannot share a process — both attach to the CUDA driver in mutually-exclusive ways per the project's NVBit injection playbook (`tools/nvbit_tracer/README.md`). The two runs are therefore executed back-to-back against bit-identical kernel binaries, and the join layer uses this manifest to match per-launch records across the two runs by `launch_match_key`. Pairs whose per-launch NVML state diverges by more than `drift_tolerance_ns` are excluded from downstream metric and gate consumers with a typed `dual_run_drift_exceeded` diagnostic.

cupti_run_id.description: Stable identifier for the CUPTI-Activity timing run. Generated at run start by `run_suite.py --mode timing` and recorded in the run's measurement manifest. The join layer rejects manifests whose `cupti_run_id` is not present in any committed CUPTI-side measurement manifest with a typed `dual_run_manifest_ambiguous` diagnostic.

nvbit_run_id.description: Stable identifier for the NVBit-instrumented trace run. Generated at run start by `run_suite.py --mode trace` and recorded in the run's measurement manifest.

drift_tolerance_ns.description: Maximum tolerated divergence in NVML state between the two runs at a per-launch boundary, in nanoseconds. The default is registered in the pre-registration TOML; this field carries the value actually applied for reproducibility. The join layer rejects per-launch pairs whose `(cupti_run_nvml_state, nvbit_run_nvml_state)` differ by more than this threshold (interpretation: see `nvml_state_divergence` definition in `canonical_serialization_spec.md`).

binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the kernel runner binary used by BOTH runs. Required to be identical across the CUPTI run and the NVBit run; if the two runs used different binaries, the manifest is invalid and emits `dual_run_manifest_binary_sha256_disagreement`.

preflight_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the preflight manifest both runs anchored against. Required to be identical across the two runs.

launches.description: Per-launch pair records. Each record describes a (kernel, shape_point, repeat_index, launch_index) tuple that is matched between the two runs by `launch_match_key`.

claim_scope.description: Claim-scope label for any downstream artifact that consumes this manifest. Local single-die measurement always uses `measured_local`; cross-die transfer claims use `methodology_transfer_only` or `deferred` per the closure plan's cross-die discipline.

claim_scope_enum.description: Cross-die claim-scope label per the closure plan's cross-die discipline acceptance criterion. `measured_local` denotes a claim grounded in observations on the local single die. `methodology_transfer_only` denotes a claim that uses local methodology applied to a die where no measurements are recorded; the consumer must accompany such claims with an explicit transfer-methodology citation. `deferred` denotes that the cross-die measurement is not yet collected.

slug.description: SimBench-BW kernel slug; matches roster.toml conventions.

shape_point.description: Shape-point identifier; the same value appears in both runs' per-launch sidecars for this pair.

kernel_signature_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical kernel-signature inputs (see `kernel_signature.spec.md`). Required to be byte-identical between the CUPTI sidecar and the NVBit summary for the pair to be admissible.

launch_match_key.description: Natural-key tuple by which the join layer matches this pair across the two runs.

throttle_reasons_bitmask.description: NVML clocks-throttle-reasons bitmask captured at the launch boundary. Bits unset means no throttling reason is currently active.

sample_timestamp_ns_host_monotonic.description: Host-monotonic timestamp of the NVML sample, nanoseconds. Same clock domain as CUPTI Activity per-launch start_ns / end_ns when CLOCK_MONOTONIC is the configured CUPTI activity timestamp clock.

nvml_state_at_launch.description: NVML covariate snapshot at the launch boundary of one run, used to detect drift between the CUPTI run and the NVBit run.
